criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Frames 1, 2 and 9 pass the showstopper test at 432 px, 9 the best; 5 reads at once. Frame 3's floodwater is a flat brown floor with no ledges or lamp and a broken waterline. Frame 4's water is an unlit rectangle with a flat blue trapezoid. Frame 6's lower half is a black box. Frame 8's car is blue tinted. Frame 2 has a grey strip at the bottom edge.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One world, one hero, one accent, a dark register with no strobing; two devices work. Frame 8 sits outside; the hero's geometry appears to drift on 3 and 6.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces. Frame 7 with the caption leads a reader toward a 177-day shutdown; frame 4's mechanism rests on TPR's paraphrase of a notice not read; frame 5's 'One is drawn here for each' is mostly off frame.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who, where named; next step thin; c9's rider stake appears on no surface; Bexar County only as a hashtag.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns the swipe; frame 2 steps back; turn on 3; 7 could be cut; the close restates the cover.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Specific and unhyped. Five TPR attributions in a row; 'Drawn to illustrate.' reads machine made.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: San Antonio night flood four days after no. 50; third autonomous vehicle deck in three weeks; one object per unit of time a house habit.

one_sentence_fix: Rebuild frame 7 so it can't read as a 177-day shutdown, and put c9's loss-of-control sentence and campaign 26E026 on the close.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Floodwater a flat brown floor; no ledge, bank or lamp; broken waterline; slab hood.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Chassis standing water sheet with ripples and a lamp streak; lit ledge and bank lamp; one continuous waterline.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Unlit dark rectangle with a flat blue trapezoid; reflects nothing.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Low roughness reflective sheet mirroring the lamps and flank; comal a thin edge; camera lower.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Lower body a solid black block; grille a slab.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Yaw 20 to 25 degrees off nose-on; low rim on the bumper.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Car through the window lit blue; crude boxes.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Light the street in sodium and drop its exposure; bevel the books.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Grey strip across the bottom edge.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Extend the ground so asphalt and foot wash reach the bottom row.
